limitations: Original CPU comparisons cover the available Intel hybrid host in protected code16/code32 with legacy paging and PAE, including CPL 0-3. Other vendors require their own profile qualification.
TableImage explicitly binds the otherwise undefined LAR bits 19:16 to the descriptor limit nibble. No compared original CPU output seeds model results, flags, memory or faults.
Exact prefix/extent admission is deliberately strict. Malformed/unsupported forms are admission errors, not a claim to emulate hardware #UD for arbitrary bytes.

Protected C delegates to the owned state executor. Existing LLVM descriptor lowering is unchanged; NeverC now exposes 28 already lowered descriptor/machine forms through its common i386/x64 builtin registry. Native generated-source execution is Linux x64; the i386 source lane remains compile-only.
Initial dirty-tree probes and pre-integration runs are retained separately and excluded from the final counts.
